human_quote: Je valide D01–D08 et tes propositions C01–C04. Enregistre mes décisions, puis prépare la matrice des contextes nécessaires et les fiches représentatives à revoir avant l’implémentation. Aucun LLM, API payante, commit ni push.
approval_basis: One actual collective human message; not twelve independent review events.

approved_decisions.proposal_summary_en: One task owns one product/column context; several steps may belong to it. Different column sizes or product scopes require distinct tasks, even for the same sample.
Keep the step distinct from requested information such as flow, buffer, volumes and endpoints. A flow request does not automatically request the whole protocol.
Buffer formulation is separate from an operating procedure; an elution-buffer request does not request operating elution flow or gradient settings.
Distinguish provided, explicitly unknown, not supplied and justified not applicable. Missing data is not zero, false or a value borrowed from another task.
Attach each exclusion to a task or information item. Inclusion for A and exclusion for B is not a contradiction.
A contradiction blocks affected items. An unavailable item does not remove unrelated supported documentary requests.
Preserve units, alternatives, approximations and conditions; no automatic conversion in the initial version. Keep bed volume, sample volume and flow distinct.
Preserve request-field origins separately from manual evidence. User input is not scientific evidence and cannot lift source quarantine.
Initial scope: HiTrap Blue HP 1 mL and 5 mL, plus general IEX/HIC/SEC questions needed for current cases. Other products remain outside scope or require clarification.

Ask for clarification only where missing information changes the requested answer; do not demand irrelevant context for general documentary principles. Resolve contradictions before affected parameters.
Start with offline structured cards and a readable per-task preview. Validate them before Chainlit integration; free text will later target the same contract.

Keep six selected seeds and 2048 serialized context tokens for the whole request, alternating requested items, deduplicating shared passages, retaining atomic dependencies and explicitly reporting unserved items.

scope_limits: Only D01-D08 and the stated C01-C04 proposals are approved.
Detailed context matrix, cards, field taxonomy, aliases and canonical mappings still require review.
No schema, form, v06 code, retrieval experiment, source approval or scientific suitability is approved or executed by this record.
